params.prompt: Use the attached reference image of this character: keep his face, hair, body shape, outfit and colors exactly consistent with it. Create a clean 3D-modeling reference turnaround of the same character in color: four full-body views of him side by side in one row, evenly spaced, all at exactly the same scale, standing on one shared ground line, with wide empty white margins between the figures so nothing touches or overlaps: 1) front view, 2) left side view with the character facing the left edge of the image, 3) back view, 4) right side view with the character facing the right edge of the image. Orthographic camera at chest height, no perspective distortion. Strict A-pose for 3D rigging: standing perfectly straight, feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart and pointing forward, legs straight and clearly separated with a visible gap between the thighs, both arms raised away from the body at about 45 degrees from the torso, elbows straight, hands open and flat with fingers spread apart and palms facing down, so there is a large clear gap between each arm and the torso and hips; the hands are far away from the thighs; nothing in the hands. The towel stays around his neck, hanging flat on his chest, not in the hands. Neutral expression with a closed mouth. The character is a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired mixed-martial-arts bantamweight champion: 175 cm, about 7.4 heads tall with realistic proportions, a lean hard athletic bantamweight build, narrow waist, defined but not bulky shoulders and arms, ropy forearms. Light warm skin. Oval face with a clean strong jawline, a straight nose, straight medium-thick black eyebrows, calm narrow eyes with single eyelids, small ears. Black hair parted at the side and swept back and up with a soft fringe falling to one side, cut short at the sides. Outfit: a plain dark grey short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#4A4A48), black loose training pants (#2A2A2C) with a thin white side stripe, dark rubber slippers (#3A3A3A) on bare feet, a small white towel around his neck (#F0EBE2), a black digital sports watch on his left wrist. Plain unbranded clothing. Rendering: flat even studio lighting from the front with almost no cast shadows and no shadow on the ground, flat muted anime cel colors with only a very light single shadow tone, clean thin dark outlines, pure plain white background, no ground line. Avoid: perspective, dramatic lighting, hands touching the body, arms hanging down, crossed legs, props held in the hands, extra characters, text, letters, labels, grid lines, numbers, logos, watermarks, cigarettes, alcohol.
